answer: Rotating Challenge-Response Ledger: each agent identity is bound to a random challenge drawn from a public plume of live entropy, and must answer within a shrinking horizon before the challenge rotates. Answers are single-use, so replay and copying fail. To sustain N identities, an attacker must run N concurrent live responders and absorb the overhead of a fresh unique computation each epoch, mining effort from limited shale-like compute reserves; costs scale linearly with fleet size, not once.
